# Setup environment
exec privage init

# Create a source file with known content
cp input.txt secret.txt

# Add (encrypt) the file
exec privage add customcat secret.txt
stderr 'Added file'

# Verify the file exists with old category
exec privage list customcat
stdout 'secret.txt'

# Rename the category
exec privage rename-cat secret.txt newcat
stderr 'Renamed category'

# Verify the file exists with new category
exec privage list newcat
stdout 'secret.txt'

# Verify the file does not exist with old category
exec privage list customcat
! stdout 'secret.txt'

# Verify the content is preserved
exec privage cat secret.txt
stdout 'secret data'

# Error case: Rename category of non-existent file
! exec privage rename-cat missing.txt targetcat
stderr 'not found'

# Error case: Rename to same category
! exec privage rename-cat secret.txt newcat
stderr 'identical'

-- input.txt --
secret data
